title: Freedom – The label.
intro: As part of my Postgraduate in Social Media Management, I created a complete mockup for Freedom, developing the brand concept, visual identity, and social media content.

sections.heading: ABOUT THE BRAND
sections.text: Freedom is an activewear brand that combines style, comfort, and sustainability. Designed for everyone, its mission is to offer clothing that empowers and celebrates diversity.

sections.heading: BRAND RELEVANCE
sections.text: The relevance of the Freedom brand lies in its ability to combine responsible fashion, style and comfort, adaptability, and a more conscious future.

sections.heading: THE FEELING
sections.text: Live beyond what is necessary, move with purpose, and dress with awareness. Your journey, your choice, your freedom.

sections.heading: THE LAUNCH.
sections.text: Freedom is being YOURSELF. The campaign communicates freedom, authenticity, sustainability and community.
